title: Attribution windows: late orders become organic and auto-opened messages are excluded
risk: An order confirmed after the attribution window is credited to the campaign anyway, so organic revenue is counted as AI revenue and the recovery rate is overstated.
preconditions: Namespace gov-kpi-<case_id>-<worker_id>; the metric is computed by the real reporting code over fixtures/offline/governance.json kpi_dataset and never copied from the dashboard payload.

Frozen clock 2026-01-15T10:00:00Z with the reporting window 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z .. 2026-02-01T00:00:00Z as a half-open interval; the stored aggregate is recomputed independently from the raw counter rows.
The 24 hour cart-recovery window and the 48 hour campaign-click window are the declared windows for this tenant, measured from the qualifying interaction to the confirmed payment.
kpi_dataset.attribution marks orders confirmed after the window as organic and excludes messages the customer never answered.

late_arrival.expected: restated as a late arrival, never silently folded into the closed window

inputs.window_boundary: half-open: an order confirmed exactly at the window edge counts as inside

steps.action: Attribute the four orders using the declared windows
steps.expected: The two orders inside their window are attributed, and ORD-W-2 and ORD-W-4 are classified as organic revenue and excluded from the campaign denominator.
An order confirmed at 48.0 hours is inside the window and one at 48.1 hours is outside, so the boundary is applied consistently and stated.

steps.action: Aggregate engagement with the 40 auto-opened messages that received no reply
steps.expected: All 40 are excluded from the engagement numerator and the engagement denominator keeps its declared impression scope.

steps.action: Attempt to credit an organic order to the campaign to improve the recovery rate
steps.expected: The attempt is refused and the order stays organic; the recovery rate numerator does not gain the order.

assertions: Every order outside its declared attribution window is classified as organic and excluded from the attributed numerator and denominator.
The window boundary is applied consistently and the comparison is inclusive of the boundary instant, so no order is both inside and outside.
Auto-opened messages with no customer reply are excluded, so engagement is not manufactured by the platform's own outgoing traffic.
The declared window per scenario is published with the metric, so a reader can reproduce the classification.

An order confirmed after the window end and delivered late is recorded as a late-arrival restatement: the closed window keeps its published figure and the difference is stated, instead of the past being silently rewritten.
forbidden: Crediting an out-of-window order to the AI to lift the conversion figure.
Counting an unanswered auto-open as engagement.
Using one window for cart recovery and campaign clicks so the boundary becomes arbitrary.
evidence: Per-order classification table with the hours since the qualifying interaction.
Engagement computation showing the excluded auto-open count.
Window declaration recorded with the metric.
cleanup: Delete gov- classification and aggregate rows after export.
automation: The reporting service and the metric dictionary run as real code under test over the frozen KPI dataset; the dashboard is a consumer whose displayed value must equal the independently recomputed value. Waits are condition-based on the stored aggregate row, metric values are never supplied as inputs, and no vendor boundary is involved in the arithmetic.
